title: Request: CascadeBio pilot - combined credit + discount exception
text:
Request: CascadeBio pilot - combined credit + discount exception

["From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CascadeBio pilot - request for combined credits + discount exception

Naomi —

Quick summary: CascadeBio (seed-stage biotech platform) is ready to kick off a 3-week pilot next month but procurement pushed back on price and contract length. Lina is asking for a modest onramp: 30% off list for first three months + $10k in free credits to cover evaluation volume. They sign fast if we can commit to these terms and a short entry SOW.

Why I think it's worth an exception:
- Strategic fit: they map to our life-sciences vertical play and will be a public case study for genomics workflows.
- Upside: forecasted ARR within 12 months if pilot shows latency/cost benefits — conservative estimate $120k ARR.
- Low technical risk: model scope is embeddings + short-completion calls; infra load reasonable.

Attached: term sheet draft (cascadebio_term_sheet_v2.pdf) and a short security snapshot they requested.

Ask: can we get exec signoff for 30% promo + $10k credits as a one-time concession (deal id DBL-2027-0091)? Need approval to finalize the DocuSign and commit resources.

If helpful I can pull forecast numbers and a one-page risk note.

Thanks,
Michael
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
", "From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CascadeBio pilot - request for combined credits + discount exception

Thanks Michael — good summary. I chatted briefly with Lina on the demo and product match looks strong. Procurement emailed a short list of standard SOW redlines; legal (cc'd) will need to confirm we can keep a three-month term and the promo tied to usage rather than a monetary rebate.

Aditya / Soojin — adding you both for pricing/approval and legal guardrails. My initial read: 30% + $10k credits is borderline but defensible given the case study potential. Need explicit approval from Marissa for any concession that exceeds $7.5k in credits or >25% discount.

Michael — please add a quick one-pager with expected ARR within 6-12 months and a short contingency plan if usage spikes.

-naomi
", "From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CascadeBio pilot - request for combined credits + discount exception

On Fri, Jun 25, 2027 at 10:04 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Michael — good summary. I chatted briefly with Lina on the demo and product match looks strong. Procurement emailed a short list of standard SOW redlines; legal (cc'd) will need to confirm we can keep a three-month term and the promo tied to usage rather than a monetary rebate.

Added a couple legal notes inline below and on the attached term sheet. Short version:
- We can do a time-limited promotional discount; it should be explicit in the SOW and linked to pilot start/end dates.
- Credits are fine as a one-time grant but must be non-refundable and expire at 90 days after issue.
- Require a brief clause that permits us to cap usage if they exceed a defined throughput to protect SLOs.

If you want me to redline the final DocuSign, I can turn it around tomorrow.

— Soojin
", 'From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: CascadeBio pilot - request for combined credits + discount exception

Marissa — forwarding a request for an exception on CascadeBio. Short bullets:
- Customer: CascadeBio (seed biotech)
- Ask: 30% off for first 3 months + $10k one-time credits
- Rationale: high potential ARR within 12 months, strong vertical fit, public case study
- Legal: Soojin ok with terms but credits must expire at 90 days; include usage caps.
- Financial: net present value on the pilot still positive; we modeled a scenario in which they convert at 15% within 6 months.

Can you weigh in on whether we can approve the concession? If yes, Michael will finalize the DocuSign and we’ll schedule kickoff.

Thanks — Aditya
', 'From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CascadeBio pilot - request for combined credits + discount exception

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the one-pager Aditya attached and the light forecast; I also asked RevOps to sanity-check the ARR lift. Given the strategic fit and the relatively small downside, I approve a one-time concession: 30% off for the first 90 days AND a $10,000 credit grant, subject to legal redlines Soojin proposed (credits expire 90 days, usage cap clause).

Please proceed with the attached term sheet and get the DocuSign executed. Confirm once signed and copy me on the kickoff notes.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
']
